selection_rationale: CPU-only NEURON+pymoo NSGA-II workload (no GPU needed). Selected offer 31639237: AMD EPYC 7B13 64-core (cpu_cores_effective=64), 252 GB host RAM, 25 GB container disk (1324 GB host), $0.2382/hr in Norway (reliability 0.9964, ~406-day duration). This is the only 64-core EPYC 7B13 offering with reliability>=0.99 in the search results today; it is architecturally identical to the t0078 working instance 36068067 (EPYC 7B13, Norway, 64 cores). Plan target was $0.1582/hr matching t0078, but no offers at that price exist today (cheapest EPYC 7B13 at any size is 36034860 at $0.2147/hr with reliability 0.9912 below the 0.99 threshold). Cheapest qualifying offer overall is 33292880 (Xeon E5-2690 v2 Ivy Bridge, $0.0947/hr, projected $0.21) but the 2013-era Xeon v2 architecture has roughly 1.5x lower per-core NEURON throughput than EPYC 7B13, so projected wall-clock would push past 2.5 h and the savings would shrink. The 64-core EPYC 7B13 here at $0.2382/hr is the closest match to the proven t0078 profile, removes architecture-uncertainty risk, and projected total cost ~$0.39 (eval ~0.93 h + provision/teardown ~0.7 h = 1.63 h * $0.2382/hr) is 26% under the $0.45 NSGA-II envelope and 80% under the $2.00 hard cap. The single idle RTX PRO 4000 GPU is included but not used; we pay for the host slice only. The dph_total $0.2382 is slightly higher than the offer dph_total $0.2290 because Vast.ai includes inet bandwidth costs in instance dph_total.

failed_attempts.failure_reason: Duplicate creation - the first vastai create call returned exit 0 with empty stdout under the run_with_logs subprocess pipe (no JSON visible to the caller), so a second create call was made which also returned empty stdout. Both create calls actually succeeded server-side, producing two instances on the same offer 31639237. Instance 36137287 came up running on ssh2.vast.ai:17286 (kept); instance 36137292 came up stopped on ssh7.vast.ai:17292 and was destroyed via 'vastai destroy instance 36137292 -y'. Same root cause as t0078's create-duplicate issue; the bug is in run_with_logs swallowing vastai's stdout when invoked under PowerShell or Bash on Windows.
